user.title: Connect to PiKVM
user.description: Enter the connection details and credentials for your PiKVM device.

data.url: URL or IP address of the PiKVM device

data_description.url: The IP address or hostname of the PiKVM device (e.g., pikvm.local).
data_description.username: Username used to log into PiKVM (default: admin).
data_description.password: Password used to log into PiKVM.
data_description.totp: Base32 two-factor authentication generator secret if 2FA is configured.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered PiKVM
zeroconf_confirm.description: A PiKVM device has been discovered on your network. Would you like to set it up?

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate PiKVM
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication failed for PiKVM at {host}. Please verify your credentials and TOTP 2FA secret.

data_description.totp: Base32 two-factor authentication generator secret if 2FA is configured.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Reconfigure PiKVM
reconfigure_confirm.description: Update connection settings or credentials for PiKVM at {host}.

data.url: URL or IP address of the PiKVM device

data_description.url: The IP address or hostname of the PiKVM device.
data_description.port: Port number for the PiKVM device if non-standard.
data_description.totp: Base32 two-factor authentication generator secret if 2FA is configured.

error.invalid_totp: The TOTP secret is not a valid base32 string.
error.timeout: The request timed out while connecting to the device.
error.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred while communicating with the device.

abort.already_configured: The device is already configured in Home Assistant, and the information is now updated.
abort.unique_id_mismatched: The reconfigured device does not match the original device's serial number.
abort.missing_serial_or_host: Discovered device is missing a serial number or host address.
abort.ipv6_address: IPv6 addresses are not supported for automatic discovery.

init.title: Configure PiKVM Options
init.description: Adjust options and polling settings for your PiKVM device.

data_description.scan_interval: Frequency in seconds to poll the PiKVM API for updates (5 to 300 seconds).

undervoltage.title: {device_name} undervoltage detected
undervoltage.description: {device_name} has detected an undervoltage condition. The device power supply or USB cable is unable to supply sufficient voltage, which can cause system instability and data corruption. Please verify that your power supply delivers at least 5.1V / 3A.

throttling.title: {device_name} CPU throttling active
throttling.description: {device_name} has triggered CPU throttling due to thermal limits or power constraints. System performance and video streaming latency may be degraded. Please check that cooling fans and heatsinks are operating properly and ventilation is unobstructed.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to PiKVM at {host}. Verify network connectivity and ensure the device is powered on.

authentication_error.message: Authentication failed for PiKVM at {host}. Verify your credentials and TOTP 2FA secret.

invalid_totp.message: The provided TOTP secret is not a valid base32 string.

cannot_fetch_cert.message: Unable to retrieve SSL/TLS certificate from PiKVM at {host}.

ssl_certificate_error.message: SSL certificate validation failed for PiKVM at {host}.
